exposure: Family history of CVD/cardiometabolic risk factors
outcome: Metabolic profile (defined by hypertension, diabetes, dyslipidemia, C-reactive protein, HOMA-IR)
Obesity with a not healthy metabolic profile
cohort: The participants were 1847 mothers from a birth cohort, initially assembled after delivery and reevaluated four years later.
finding: Four years after delivery, a healthy excessive weight phenotype exists in women, with 61% of women with normal BMI, 33% of overweight women, and 12% of obese women presenting a healthy metabolic profile, and longer breastfeeding and physical exercise being protective against obesity with an unhealthy metabolic profile.
